Match day is Saturday, and every session in this block is placed by its distance from match day. These two post-football lifts are deliberately small and repeatable. The early-week session keeps a short acceleration dose, your squat exposure, and hamstring capacity; the later-week session is deliberately low-cost and match-protective. In-season, holding speed, squat strength, and clean hamstring work on the same weekly schedule is success.

Weeks 2-4: only the running variable progresses if the prior week stayed clean. Tuesday accelerations get 5 m longer through Week 3, Thursday shuttle rest trims by 5 s through Week 3, while the squat and hamstring strength doses stay steady. Week 4 keeps the main loads but cuts accessory volume and one run rep so you finish fresher, not detrained.

Pain/substitution: mild right-hamstring awareness that fully warms out is the ceiling. If tightness builds during Run, Shuttle Run, or Nordic Hamstring Curl, stop the faster or eccentric row first, keep only normal-looking strength work, and repeat the last clean week. Sharp pain, radiating symptoms, loss of stride, or next-day tightness above baseline means skip hamstring loading and get staff eyes on it. If Nordic Hamstring Curl feels too grabby on a given day, replace that row with Machine Hamstring Curl 2 x 8 at RPE 6-7.

WEEKLY SCHEDULE
The sport is the load. The gym is placed around it, and the day before a match is protected.

 | Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun
Every week | Football light | Football hard + gym | Football moderate | Football hard + gym | rest (protected) | Football MATCH | rest

This repeats for all four weeks: the fixture repeats, so the week does. Progress is measured in what the athlete can do on this schedule, not in load added to it.

Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Tue	[WARMUP] Run	N/A	1	4 min	N/A	3	4 min easy run plus mobility and 2 progressive buildups. Take 2 quick Back Squat ramp sets after the Run row.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 47.5 kg x 5, 72.5 kg x 3, 92.5 kg x 1-2 before 120 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	Back Squat	120 kg	2	3	3:00	7	About 80% of the 150 kg max. Up to 2 work sets; stop after 1 if RPE exceeds 8, bar speed drops, or technique shifts.	
Tue	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	8	1:30	7	Clean scapular retraction and controlled lowering.	
Tue	Overhead Press	RPE-selected load	2	5	2:00	6.5	Submaximal support work; hold the same load if the second set slows.	
Tue	Nordic Hamstring Curl	Bodyweight	2	3	2:30	7	Controlled 3-4 second lower with light hand push on the way up. Stop before the right side loses length or cramps.	
Tue	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	30 s/side	0:45	6	Keep ribs down and pelvis level.	
Tue	Run	N/A	4	20 m	2:30	N/A	Fast relaxed accelerations with full recovery. If timed keep reps within about 3% of the best one; stop if speed drops or the right hamstring feels sticky.	
Thu	[WARMUP] Run	N/A	1	4 min	N/A	3	4 min easy run plus mobility and 2 progressive turn buildups. Take 2 quick Barbell Hip Thrust ramp sets after the Shuttle Run row; this session stays low-cost before the weekend.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Thu	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	2	6	2:00	6.5	Low-eccentric posterior-chain support. Hold load if football legs are heavy.	
Thu	Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	10	1:30	7	Smooth pull to lower ribs with no shrugging.	
Thu	Overhead Press	RPE-selected load	2	5	2:00	6	Easy crisp reps only; no grinding.	
Thu	Machine Hamstring Curl	RPE-selected load	2	8	1:30	7	Controlled squeeze and lower under control; keep it non-sore.	
Thu	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	2	10/side	0:45	6	Brace and resist rotation. First accessory to remove if time or legs are poor.	
Thu	Shuttle Run	N/A	4	20 m	1:15	N/A	10 m out plus 10 m back. Fast even turns; smooth and crisp, not exhaustive. Stop if turn quality or hamstring feel drops.
